pages.text: Draw small and medium circles with ordinary Ritual Chalk around one Focal glyph. Offer four Dirt, two White Sage and two Salt separately. Coarse Dirt and Podzol also count. The ritual makes sixteen Purifying Earth blocks.

It costs 200 power to start and 20 per second for two seconds: 240 total. The altar or a carried Grimoire pays each whole payment. Hecate's Visage reduces the total to 210 by discounting startup only.

This dirt-like block releases white particles and drops itself when mined. Silver-weak creatures that are not werewolves ignite for 25 seconds when walking over it. Cold-iron-weak creatures ignite only if not already burning.

Targets come from the material weakness entity tags; bewitchment:werewolves supplies the silver exception. The cold iron tag now includes the restored demon and spirit families. Fire immunity still prevents ignition; ordinary untagged wildlife is unaffected.
